missing_data_policy: reject incomplete event windows; do not interpolate or silently fill

event_detection.threshold: daily areal precipitation quantile 0.90 within each window
event_detection.cluster_rule: events separated by fewer than 3 dry days are grouped

reference_flow: CDR2 gauge-constrained satellite-extended reconstruction; not raw gauge observation
status: pre-analysis protocol; final event catalogue is frozen only after test-period completeness check
